your_book:
Thursday was a split session for Jaleel's book, with the portfolio clocking a modest net positive day on balance across the top weights even as a couple of chip names dragged. The standout movers were ADBE (+3.56%), ONON (+2.47%), AZO (+2.26%), EFX (+2.18%), and ZTS (+2.14%) — a diverse group that held the session together. BSX continued its slow rehabilitation with a +1.11% day, though at –14.2% unrealized it remains one of the deeper underwater positions, and the FY26 guidance cut (flagged to Oct 28 earnings) means the thesis is still being tested against deteriorating fundamentals. On the negative side, RKLB fell another –4.89%, extending its –12.7% unrealized loss on a name the model already rates AVOID — price and thesis are not diverging here, they are aligned in the wrong direction. NVDA shed –2.94% and AVGO –4.35%, both hit by headlines around OpenAI revenue coming in well below prior estimates, which dented AI-capex sentiment across the semiconductor complex.

The drift worth flagging is ADBE: it popped +3.56% today, yet the risk flag is clear — the narrative (AI-moat erosion, CFO exit) has been overriding solid numbers for months. Today's headline that Adobe is among the IT sourcing firms suspended from a federal labor certification program is a new overhang that deserves monitoring regardless of today's price action. LULU continues to carry a –27.5% unrealized loss on a guidance-cut story; a +0.87% day changes nothing structurally with Americas comps running –5% for a fifth straight quarter. BSX earnings on Oct 28 and ABT on Oct 21 are the near-term catalysts that will either validate or further stress the healthcare cluster.

Heading into Friday, the items to watch are the chip complex's reaction to any follow-on OpenAI revenue commentary (NVDA, AVGO both sitting on intraday weakness) and whether RKLB's slide continues — at 7.7% weight and AVOID-rated, it is the clearest misalignment between allocation and conviction in the book.

attention.headline: AVOID-rated at 7.7% weight, down –4.89% today, –12.7% unrealized
attention.note: Price continues to move against the position on a name the model explicitly rates AVOID — the weight is too large for the conviction level and the loss is deepening with no offsetting thesis support.

attention.headline: Federal labor certification suspension adds new headline risk to existing narrative overhang
attention.note: Today's +3.56% gain is welcome but the suspension of Adobe from a major federal IT sourcing program is a fresh negative catalyst sitting on top of the existing AI-disruption and CFO-exit concerns — the narrative risk is getting louder, not quieter.

attention.headline: Oct 28 earnings will test whether guidance cut is the floor or the start of further resets
attention.note: At –14.2% unrealized with FY26 growth already slashed and management guiding flat through Q3, the upcoming print is a binary moment for whether the STRONG BUY thesis can survive another guidance revision.

attention.headline: AI-capex sentiment hit by OpenAI revenue shortfall report; –2.94% today
attention.note: The headline driving AVGO and NVDA lower today — OpenAI annualized revenue reportedly ~$20B below prior estimates — directly targets the demand narrative underpinning Jaleel's chip exposure, and export-control risk remains live into Nov 17 earnings.
